rawText: different risk management approach that you should do depending on the approach you should have so the first risk management approach is the conservative approach where it's risking anywhere from 0.5 to 1% per trade now I know this might seem like a little bit but again keep in mind big numbers keep in mind $100,000 $200,000 which realistically it is extremely accessible to anybody out there as soon as you have the skill set so you risk anywhere from 0.5 to 1% every single trade and this is what I personally recommend to Traders taking trades on the lower time frame simply because you're getting in and out of the market more frequently so you can see yourself taking more amount of Trades and you don't want to be taking a lot of trades on high risk so this is where you lower your risk but you can take more trades where then inevitably it can make you more money so the conservative approach is meant for lower time frame traders that are executing more trades either one to three trades a day or even one to three trades a session my second point is my recommended risk management
sectionTitle: Conservative - 0.5 to 1% per trade, for lower-timeframe traders
